# Contributing to Bloxicon

The Vita client is source-available under the
[Bloxicon Source-Available License](../LICENSE). Rendering code in `Rendering/`
is [GPL-3.0-only](../Rendering/LICENSE); contributions to it are GPL-3.0-only too.

## Pull requests to this repository

Fixes and improvements sent back to this repository as pull requests are
welcome without asking first. By submitting one, you agree to the contribution
terms in section 7 of the license.

## Modifications and new clients

Anything else needs the owner's written permission before you start, including:

- modified versions of Bloxicon kept or shared outside this repository;
- new clients, ports or forks based on Bloxicon;
- distributing or hosting builds;
- using the Bloxicon name or branding, even with only the GPL rendering code;
- connecting a modified client to official Bloxicon services.

Open a [permission request](../../../issues/new?template=permission-request.yml)
for each base you want to build on (a specific Bloxicon release or commit and
part of the client). The owner will discuss it with you in that issue. Approval
for one base does not cover another base, a later version or a different
project.

If your request is approved, you must publish your project's complete source
code publicly, free of charge and under the Bloxicon license, every time you
release a build or run it as a service, and keep it available. You must also
say your project is based on Bloxicon and link to your approval. See section 6
of the license.

Your project must not make money in any way: no paid currency, cosmetics,
items, game passes, access or builds, no real-money trading, and no ads,
donations, tips, subscriptions or crowdfunding. Requests for paid projects are
declined.
